author: ETA PRIME
description:
Today we are checking out the highly anticipated US version of the Lenovo Legion Tab Gen 5, arguably the best 8-inch gaming tablet on the market right now. We are unboxing the US bundle, which includes a 68-watt charger, a screen protector, and an awesome magnetic folio case that doubles as a stand. Powered by the massive Snapdragon 8 Gen 5 and running Android 16, we are putting this device through its paces with native Android gaming, high-resolution retro emulation, and even x86 PC emulation!
